# What CircleCI API tokens the library redacts, and what it leaves alone.
#
# Every token here is built from the ordered run 0123456789abcdef, which no real
# credential is: the middle is twenty-two letters and digits, so the run with
# 012345 behind it is one, and the tail is forty hexadecimal characters, so the
# run twice over with 01234567 behind it is one. A prefix in front and the
# separator between bring a token to seventy.

patterns: circleci-api-token

# The two prefixes CircleCI writes a token with. They are one pattern rather
# than two because the string behind them is the same and neither of the two
# credentials is published where the other authenticates — the scope a project
# token carries is not written in it, so a caller told CCIPRJ_ from CCIPAT_ is
# still not told whether that token could write.

case:     a personal api token in an environment assignment
in:       CIRCLE_TOKEN=CCIPAT_0123456789abcdef012345_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
out:      CIRCLE_TOKEN=«circleci-api-token»

case:     a project api token on its own
in:       CCIPRJ_0123456789abcdef012345_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
out:      «circleci-api-token»

case:     a token in the header the api authenticates with
in:       Circle-Token: CCIPAT_0123456789abcdef012345_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
out:      Circle-Token: «circleci-api-token»

case:     a token on the curl command line the documentation writes
in:       curl -H "Circle-Token: CCIPAT_0123456789abcdef012345_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567" https://circleci.com/api/v2/me
out:      curl -H "Circle-Token: «circleci-api-token»" https://circleci.com/api/v2/me

case:     a project token in the query a status badge carries
in:       https://circleci.com/gh/acme/web.svg?style=svg&circle-token=CCIPRJ_0123456789abcdef012345_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
out:      https://circleci.com/gh/acme/web.svg?style=svg&circle-token=«circleci-api-token»

case:     both kinds on one line
in:       CCIPAT_0123456789abcdef012345_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567 CCIPRJ_0123456789abcdef012345_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
out:      «circleci-api-token» «circleci-api-token»

# The alphabets either side of the separator. The middle is the letters of both
# cases with the digits, which is wider than the base58 CircleCI names and
# admits the O, the I and the l that base58 leaves out; the tail is hexadecimal
# of either case. Neither admits anything else, the hyphen and a second
# underscore among them.

case:     a middle carrying the letters base58 leaves out
in:       CCIPAT_0123456789abcdefOIl012_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
out:      «circleci-api-token»

case:     an uppercase tail
in:       CCIPAT_0123456789abcdef012345_0123456789ABCDEF0123456789ABCDEF01234567
out:      «circleci-api-token»

case:     a middle carrying an underscore
in:       CCIPAT_0123456789abcdef_12345_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
out:      CCIPAT_0123456789abcdef_12345_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567

case:     a middle carrying a hyphen
in:       CCIPAT_0123456789abcdef-12345_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
out:      CCIPAT_0123456789abcdef-12345_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567

case:     a tail carrying a hyphen
in:       CCIPAT_0123456789abcdef012345_0123456789abcdef-123456789abcdef01234567
out:      CCIPAT_0123456789abcdef012345_0123456789abcdef-123456789abcdef01234567

case:     a tail carrying a letter outside hexadecimal
in:       CCIPAT_0123456789abcdef012345_0123456789abcdeg0123456789abcdef01234567
out:      CCIPAT_0123456789abcdef012345_0123456789abcdeg0123456789abcdef01234567

case:     a middle of uppercase letters
in:       CCIPAT_ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUV_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
out:      «circleci-api-token»

case:     a middle of lowercase letters past f
in:       CCIPAT_abcdefghijklmnopqrstuv_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
out:      «circleci-api-token»

case:     a letter outside hexadecimal at the start of the tail
in:       CCIPAT_0123456789abcdef012345_g123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
out:      CCIPAT_0123456789abcdef012345_g123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567

case:     a hyphen at the start of the middle
in:       CCIPAT_-123456789abcdef012345_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
out:      CCIPAT_-123456789abcdef012345_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567

# The lengths either side of each count. Both counts are read exactly rather
# than as floors: a middle of twenty-one characters is no token, and a tail of
# forty-two is a token and two characters that belong to no credential. The
# second of those is the price of having no boundary behind the match — a
# boundary there would drop this token rather than trim it, and a real token
# written against a digit would come through whole.

case:     a middle of twenty-two characters and a tail of forty is a token
in:       CCIPAT_0123456789abcdef012345_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
out:      «circleci-api-token»

case:     a middle of twenty-one characters is not
in:       CCIPAT_0123456789abcdef01234_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
out:      CCIPAT_0123456789abcdef01234_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567

case:     a tail of thirty-nine characters is not
in:       CCIPAT_0123456789abcdef012345_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456
out:      CCIPAT_0123456789abcdef012345_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456

case:     a hexadecimal run longer than a tail is a token and what follows it
in:       CCIPAT_0123456789abcdef012345_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789
out:      «circleci-api-token»89

# What opens a token and what does not. The prefixes are read in the one case
# CircleCI writes them, and the kind is read as one of the two the vendor
# issues.

case:     a lowercase prefix
in:       ccipat_0123456789abcdef012345_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
out:      ccipat_0123456789abcdef012345_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567

case:     a kind the vendor writes no token with
in:       CCIORG_0123456789abcdef012345_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
out:      CCIORG_0123456789abcdef012345_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567

case:     the prefix without its closing underscore
in:       CCIPAT0123456789abcdef012345_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
out:      CCIPAT0123456789abcdef012345_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567

case:     a prefix in mixed case
in:       CciPat_0123456789abcdef012345_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
out:      CciPat_0123456789abcdef012345_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567

case:     a kind sharing the personal token's opening
in:       CCIPAX_0123456789abcdef012345_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
out:      CCIPAX_0123456789abcdef012345_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567

# The token CircleCI issued before it put a prefix on one, which is forty
# hexadecimal characters and nothing else. The changelog announcing the prefixes
# left those working, and this pattern locates none of them: the value says
# nothing about itself, so what would locate it is the name it is assigned to,
# which is a grammar this pattern's name does not cover.

case:     the older format in an environment assignment
in:       CIRCLE_TOKEN=0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
out:      CIRCLE_TOKEN=0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567

case:     the body of a token without the prefix in front of it
in:       0123456789abcdef012345_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
out:      0123456789abcdef012345_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567

# The environment a job runs with, which is the text this scan most often runs
# over. Every variable of it is written CIRCLE_ something, and CIRCLE_ is seven
# characters closing on an underscore with a C six characters in front — a
# prefix's shape exactly — so the scan reads a prefix back at each of them and
# finds none.

case:     the environment a job runs with
in:       CIRCLE_PROJECT_REPONAME=web CIRCLE_BRANCH=main CIRCLE_BUILD_NUM=4213
out:      CIRCLE_PROJECT_REPONAME=web CIRCLE_BRANCH=main CIRCLE_BUILD_NUM=4213

case:     a log line naming the api a token is sent to
in:       time=2026-08-29T00:00:00Z level=info msg="calling api" url=https://circleci.com/api/v2/me
out:      time=2026-08-29T00:00:00Z level=info msg="calling api" url=https://circleci.com/api/v2/me

# Where a token may be written against a word character, and where one may begin
# inside another. There is no boundary on either side of a match, so a token
# keeps its span whatever it abuts; and a tail may close on the C a prefix opens
# with, so the last two characters of one can begin the token written after it.
# The two spans overlap there and are redacted as one.

case:     a token written straight after an underscore
in:       CIRCLE_TOKEN_CCIPAT_0123456789abcdef012345_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
out:      CIRCLE_TOKEN_«circleci-api-token»

case:     a word written against a token
in:       CCIPAT_0123456789abcdef012345_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567suffix
out:      «circleci-api-token»suffix

case:     a token beginning at the last character of another
in:       CCIPAT_0123456789abcdef012345_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456CCIPAT_0123456789abcdef012345_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
out:      «circleci-api-token»

case:     a token flush against a multi-byte rune on both sides
in:       日本語CCIPAT_0123456789abcdef012345_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567日本語
out:      日本語«circleci-api-token»日本語

case:     a token in a json field
in:       {"token":"CCIPAT_0123456789abcdef012345_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567"}
out:      {"token":"«circleci-api-token»"}

case:     a token in a configuration file
in:       token: CCIPAT_0123456789abcdef012345_0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
out:      token: «circleci-api-token»
